whenToUse: Banners with a bar, concert, or night mood.
Large headings in a dark theme.
whenNotToUse: The glow would lower the contrast.
accessibility: Check that large styled text still contrasts with its background.
Screen readers should hear the same phrase as is, not the decorated letters.
The phrase keeps its meaning even with the decorative effect removed.
A toggle to compare with plain text shows the difference the effect makes.
